infoItems: El reto
Revisar miles de normas y trámites manualmente requiere tiempo y dificulta detectar posibles barreras.
La solución
RegLAC organiza información regulatoria y ayuda a identificar oportunidades de simplificación.
Cómo usa la IA
Agentes especializados analizan disposiciones y aplican criterios para señalar posibles hallazgos.
Qué permite
Explorar regulaciones, analizar trámites y apoyar decisiones con información estructurada.
Lo más importante
Las personas expertas verifican los hallazgos y los gobiernos deciden qué reformas considerar.
es.infoNote: La evidencia informa. Las personas deciden.

en.description: Artificial intelligence to explore regulations, detect potential barriers, and support simplification decisions.
en.infoBody: Learn about the challenge, how RegLAC works, its uses, and benefits.
en.gameBody: Find repeated requirements and discover how AI makes analysis easier.
en.waiting: The infographic is on the main display. The minigame will be available in a few seconds.
en.introBody: Find repeated requirements and discover how AI helps analyze regulations.
en.missionBody: Identify the 2 documents that contain a repeated requirement.
en.manualBody: Find the 2 documents that repeat a requirement.
explanations: Documents A and C request a valid commercial registration certificate.
Documents B and D request evidence of food handling training, using different wording.
en.review: A potential match requires technical review. It does not by itself prove an irregularity or justify repealing a regulation.
en.transition: What if you had to review thousands of regulations?
en.transitionBody: Discover how RegLAC helps organize and analyze large volumes of information.
en.simulation: Simulated demonstration · Fictional documents · No live AI analysis
en.manualResult: Manual search for the repeated requirement.
en.aiResult: Documents organized and related phrases highlighted.
en.miss: The match was shown for review
en.timing: Actual interaction times for this demonstration. Round 2 includes 6 seconds of animation; it does not measure actual RegLAC processing.
en.closing: RegLAC helps analyze complex regulations. Human experts validate findings and governments make decisions.
en.duration: Approximate duration: 45–60 s · No time limit
en.displayHelp: Control the experience from the tablet.
en.noFullscreen: Full screen is unavailable in this browser.
en.readScreen: Read the documents on the main display and select your answer here.
en.infoSubtitle: A clearer way to understand complex regulations.
en.evidence: RegLAC does not replace experts: it supports them with evidence.
infoItems: The challenge
Manually reviewing thousands of regulations and procedures takes time and makes potential barriers difficult to spot.
The solution
RegLAC organizes regulatory information and helps identify opportunities for simplification.
How AI is used
Specialized agents analyze provisions and apply criteria to flag potential findings.
What it enables
Explore regulations, examine procedures, and support decisions with structured information.
Most important
Human experts verify findings and governments decide which reforms to consider.
